problem: Identity must work for 438 rows without norm_id
evidence: 507 audited records, four exact registry sources
options_considered: Resolve valid metadata, stable ID then canonical source
decision: Runtime resolver; conflicting known identities/sectors are rejected
reason_public: Identity comes from existing structure, not retrieval similarity or status

problem: Bounded parser must not truncate unsupported references
evidence: Single norm/article minimum; review found list/suffix prefix truncation
decision: Single bound reference only; lists/ranges/plural/suffixed unsupported expressions fall back
reason_public: Avoid exact lookup of incomplete or different provisions
actual_effect: New RED regressions cover ou,slash,suffix,fraction,seguintes,en/em dash and &

problem: Two retrieval functions need three internal strategies
evidence: Facade query contract already has discriminant
decision: Unique known norm+article -> metadata_exact; known norm+semantic remainder -> vector_filtered; else dense

problem: Multiple references are not one exact target
decision: Multiple norms/articles or unbound clauses use existing dense
reason_public: V1 does not add a partial multi-lookup implementation

problem: Unknown patterns should not invent norm identity
evidence: Registry has finite canonical norm IDs
decision: Unknown norm keeps dense unless known reference conflicts with router
reason_public: Avoid aggressive blocking while preserving a known conflict
actual_effect: Unknown plus known conflict is still scope_conflict

problem: Retrieval cannot silently replace router scope
evidence: Known norm sector is explicitly in registry
decision: Conflict stops before collection/embedding; public existing invalid_request and private scope_conflict+routed_scope
reason_public: No new public error taxonomy is needed
actual_effect: One controlled conflict out of 15 probes, no retrieval

problem: Metadata exact has no vector score
evidence: RetrievedChunk and legacy Reference required float
decision: Only two distance fields widen to float|None; exact emits None
reason_public: Same downstream DTO without fictional similarity; dense floats unchanged
actual_effect: Model text differs only in two annotations

evidence: Real metadata has original_index and stable IDs
decision: Order by original_index,chunk_id then assign rank1..N, cap existing top_k
reason_public: Structural order does not imply semantic score
actual_effect: Duplicate article fixture has deterministic ordering

problem: Norm filter must act before nearest top-k
decision: Read metadata, resolve IDs and apply sector/exclusions; pass IDs into same Chroma cosine query
reason_public: Covers absent norm_id and avoids post-filter loss
actual_effect: 15/15 returned filtered candidates in controlled probes belong to target norm

problem: Temporal applicability is not a retrieval decision
evidence: Frozen graph routes and classifies temporal intent before retrieve
decision: Unchanged graph computes exclusions; all candidate paths reach same VersionFilter/grounding/V2
reason_public: No legal status decision or output generation in new engines
actual_effect: Current revoked evidence blocked; historical evidence retained

problem: Concurrent invocations must not share active strategy
decision: Construct adapter/core per query; shared dependencies remain read-only
actual_effect: Concurrent mixed and two-filtered tests pass

problem: Audit must survive persistence without public schema changes
decision: Private counts/filters/candidates/identity methods; dense candidate_count null when unmeasured
reason_public: Explicit persistence roundtrip remains equivalent; no extra dense collection reads
actual_effect: Four strategy mapping tests verify private roundtrip and public exclusion

problem: Dense path is frozen and index failures should keep meaning
evidence: New engines bypassed empty-index guard in review
options_considered: Delegate unchanged dense and check new-path index
decision: Dense forwards all args unchanged; new paths check index availability without embeddings
reason_public: No strategy-dependent reinterpretation of empty index
actual_effect: Dense2/2 preservation; both empty-index regressions pass

problem: F2 is a regression case, not a quality study
evidence: Saved TEMP-GRAD-002 query names177/2012 art68; old dense miss recorded
options_considered: Tune embeddings or rerun model experiment
decision: Use saved query unchanged for exact lookup; preserve calendar abstention downstream
reason_public: Finding an article does not establish its applicability in requested year
actual_effect: Exact article found; facade returnsERROR under frozen requested-year restriction

problem: Raw pytest RED console has diagnostic trailing spaces
evidence: git diff --cached --check found 13 trailing-whitespace lines in tdd_red.txt
options_considered: Preserve bytes with file-specific whitespace attribute
decision: Keep raw stdout; disable whitespace checking only for this evidence file in local .gitattributes
reason_public: Preserves observed test output without relaxing production-code or other artifact checks
actual_effect: Raw stdout SHA-256 unchanged; staged diff check exits0 with scoped exception
